## entities.ts

`entities.ts` is `lib/maps/entities.json` from the npm package [entities](https://github.com/fb55/entities) 2.2.0, rewritten as a TypeScript object literal with sorted keys and no other change. It holds the 2,125 semicolon-terminated named character references of the WHATWG HTML standard. Licence: BSD-2-Clause, reproduced from the package's `LICENSE`.

sha256 of the upstream `lib/maps/entities.json`: `d43e0484a302ac1b84636250ff65cc735811b52bf99525b3d30a81b75436a9a8`
